# Use the OH media/clipboard route rather than Android permission assumptions

## Platform difference

Android media-library and clipboard code paths may require different OH plugins, dialogs and permission handling.

## Implementation

LocalSend selects ImagePicker for OH instead of its AssetPicker/PhotoManager UI and restricts clipboard import to plain text with rejected/empty-read handling. PixEz uses an OH gallery plugin for image saving. KikoFlu routes image export through SaverGallery while keeping Android storage/photo permission requests Android-only. NJU declares READ_PASTEBOARD with a localized reason/in-use scene. Nomark uses the native asset-creation dialog for media destinations.

## Applicability

Permission needs depend on the native operation and SDK version; these examples do not prescribe a universal permission list.

These observations apply to the pinned project revisions below, studied on 2026-09-30 and backfilled on 2026-10-06. Unspecified SDK/device compatibility remains unknown; this is not a fresh upstream assessment.

## Pitfalls and limitations

A manifest declaration is not a runtime grant, and clipboard text support is not clipboard file/image support. Do not blindly transfer Android permission names to OH or request unrelated permissions because a plugin README contains boilerplate.

## Verification

Exercise allowed/denied/empty clipboard reads and media save cancellation; check actual gallery visibility, bytes and permission behavior on supported API/device variants.

Evidence tier: historical source/diff studies, with commit and path existence rechecked in local Git during this backfill. No application build, dependency resolution, signing, installation or device execution was performed. Proposed checks above are acceptance criteria, not completed tests.
